description: Figure: coordination sphere and bond valence of the CHAPK crystal zinc compared with reference catalytic and structural zinc sites computed with identical code
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

agg = pd.read_csv("provenance/table_zinc_benchmark_summary.csv")
agg["short"] = ["CHAP_K Zn\n(4CSH)", "CHAP_K Ca\n(4CSH)", "CHAP_K Na\n(4CSH)",
                "T7 lysozyme\nAmidase_2 Zn", "Carbonic\nanhydrase II", "Thermolysin",
                "ADH Zn site 1", "ADH Zn site 2", "Zif268\nzinc finger"]
col = {"test case":"#c0392b", "structural (internal control)":"#2980b9",
       "adventitious (internal control)":"#7f8c8d", "catalytic":"#27ae60",
       "catalytic or structural":"#27ae60", "structural":"#8e44ad"}
c = [col[r] for r in agg.assigned_role]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(16, 5.2))

ax[0].bar(agg.short, agg.prot_lig, color=c)
ax[0].axhspan(3, 4, color="#27ae60", alpha=0.12)
ax[0].set_ylabel("protein ligands within 3.2 A")
ax[0].set_title("Coordination by protein atoms")
ax[0].text(0.02, 0.93, "shaded band: 3-4 ligands,\nthe range of every reference site",
           transform=ax[0].transAxes, fontsize=8, va="top")

ax[1].bar(agg.short, agg.BVS, color=c)
ax[1].axhline(2.0, ls="--", c="k", lw=1)
ax[1].text(8.4, 2.05, "expected valence 2 for Zn(II) and Ca(II)", ha="right", fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_ylabel("bond valence sum")
ax[1].set_title("Bond valence sum, Brown-Altermatt")

ax[2].scatter(agg.prot_lig, agg.BVS, c=c, s=120, zorder=3)
for _, r in agg.iterrows():
    ax[2].annotate(r.short.replace("\n", " "), (r.prot_lig, r.BVS),
                   textcoords="offset points", xytext=(7, -3), fontsize=7.5)
ax[2].set_xlabel("protein ligands"); ax[2].set_ylabel("bond valence sum")
ax[2].set_xlim(0.3, 6.9); ax[2].set_title("The CHAP_K zinc sits apart from both reference classes")

for a in ax[:2]:
    a.tick_params(axis="x", labelsize=7.5, rotation=55)
fig.suptitle("The zinc on Cys54 of LysK CHAP_K has one protein ligand and a bond valence of 1.1, "
             "unlike catalytic or structural zinc sites", fontsize=11)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
